patch.description: The course as the front edits it. Sent to the e-learning service: `title`, `description`, `category`, `level` (else read from `levelBadge`), `mandatory` (else `titleBadge.variant` = `mandatory`), `deadline`, `source` (default `internal`), `instructor` (else `details.instructor`) and `details.chapters[].contents[]` (`type`, `title`, `description`, `durationSeconds` or `duration`, `required` (default `true`), `href` for a link). Other fields are ignored. Full replacement: the chapters and contents whose `id` is the decimal id of an existing row are kept (a stored file keeps its file and its type), the others are created (a new content can only be a `link`, a `quiz` or `other`), and the rows left out are deleted.
